# Active Repository Packet

- **Packet:** `repository-step-23-cloudflare-native-experiment` — Cloudflare CRM: simple working customers, contacts, deals and tasks pilot
- **Status:** `active`

- **Source digest:** `sha256:`

## Objective

Build a simple, usable test CRM on one Cloudflare Worker + D1 with React UI. Prioritize working functionality and speed. Defer optional hardening and infrastructure additions until after real production.

## Deliverables

- `dedicated CRM account and D1; no unrelated account changes`
- `single Worker with Access-verified identity and tenant-scoped records`
- `create, list, edit, search and delete customers, contacts, deals and tasks`
- `React/Vite UI built and deployed as Cloudflare Static Assets`
- `simple Node tests, source CI and one native Wrangler deployment`
- `preserve earlier G2 and do not merge historical Docker G3`
- `live Chromium E2E after deploy using existing Access service token`
